chunks: A gift in the Torah is an eye-coverer.

key_terms.التَّوْرَاةِ: the Torah, cited here as a source of this description
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْهَدِيَّةُ: a gift given to another person
key_terms.عَيْنًا: the eye, meaning sight or notice in context

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the value of a gift?
ai.summary: The hadith presents a concise ethical teaching about the effect of giving gifts. It indicates that a gift has the quality of covering or overlooking faults in social dealings, highlighting its role in fostering goodwill.
